headline: FACE launches to manage AI coding agents, keeping dev teams in sync across projects
summary: FACE is a new free binary that integrates with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Copilot, providing a clear overview of project progress, costs, and decisions across multiple sessions and team members on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
details: FACE, a new free binary, has launched to solve the common problem of unreadable and untracked projects when using coding agents. It integrates with agents like Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and OpenCode, allowing teams to maintain a clear thread of development. The tool is available for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

The system works by planting a small method within your project folder, creating documents, a delivery queue, and a page detailing what will be built and how it will be proven. These files are then projected as a board, a live session screen, and a commit window. Users retain control, as the agent never commits code directly; you click to approve.

FACE has already proven its effectiveness, having been used to ship a job marketplace in 89 deliveries over 14 days and a consulting project in 107 deliveries over 19 days. The tool itself was also built using this very method, showcasing its capability in managing complex development workflows.

Supporting six programming languages, FACE connects to your existing agent through the Agent Client Protocol without ever seeing your login credentials. While the free tier remains available, the source code will be visible under a fair source license when a team tier is introduced in the future.
caption:

headline: Google launches its 'universal' online shopping cart for holiday season
summary: The new AI-powered tool unifies products from multiple retailers into a single cart, offering price drop alerts and promo codes, rolling out in the US.
details: Google's AI-powered Universal Cart is now rolling out in the US, just in time for holiday shopping. This tool, previewed at I/O, aims to simplify online shopping by organizing products and saving money.

The 'universal' digital cart allows users to save items from multiple retailers into one unified space, working across the Gemini app and Google Search. Google plans to integrate it with Gmail and YouTube, though a timeline is not yet announced.

Users will receive notifications for price drops and restocks on saved items, eliminating the need to check individual retailer websites. The cart also displays relevant promotional codes to help users save more.

Payment options include Google Wallet or direct checkout with the retailer. Universal Cart can analyze saved credit cards to suggest the best payment method based on perks. This launch intensifies competition in the AI-assisted shopping market.
caption:
